data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'Zacchaios' meaning 'pure, righteous, innocent'. In the New Testament, Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, is converted by Jesus. The name Zacchino carries the meaning “Righteous, pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zacchino usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Zacchino belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous, pure.”

in_hebrew.name: זאקינו
in_hebrew.meaning: זאקינו הוא שמו של מי שזוכר את אלוהים או מי שאלוהים זוכר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זאקינו הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו הוא מי שזוכר את אלוהים או מי שאלוהים זוכר. השם נגזר מהשורש העברי 'זכר' שפירושו לזכור או להזכיר. השם זאקינו משויך לאדם שזוכר את אלוהים ומקיים את מצוותיו.

in_greek.name: Ζακχίνο
in_greek.meaning: Ζακχίνο σημαίνει αυτός που θυμάται τον Θεό ή αυτός που ο Θεός θυμάται
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζακχίνο είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει αυτός που θυμάται τον Θεό ή αυτός που ο Θεός θυμάται. Το όνομα Ζακχίνο προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'זכר' που σημαίνει να θυμάμαι ή να ανακαλώ. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ζακχίνο δεν αναφέρεται ρητά, αλλά η σημασία του συνδέεται με την παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Zacchino
in_latin.meaning: Zacchino significat qui Deum recordatur aut cui Deus recordatur
in_latin.long_meaning: Zacchino est nomen quod originem habet in lingua hebraica et significat qui Deum recordatur aut cui Deus recordatur. Nomen Zacchino derivatur a radice hebraica 'זכר' quod significat recordari aut commemorare. Nomen Zacchino in Ecclesia primitiva non invenitur, sed significatio eius cum traditione ecclesiastica connectitur.

in_english.name: Zacchino
in_english.meaning: Zacchino means one who remembers God or whom God remembers
in_english.long_meaning: Zacchino is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning one who remembers God or whom God remembers. The name originates from the Hebrew word 'zakar,' which means to remember or recall. Although Zacchino is not directly mentioned in the Bible, its significance is tied to the biblical tradition of remembering God's covenant and faithfulness. Historically, the name Zacchino has been used in Christian communities to signify a person's devotion to God and their commitment to following His teachings.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Zacchino" is of Hebrew origin, and its meaning, "pure, righteous, innocent," has been associated with strong moral character and integrity throughout history and various cultures. The unique Italian adaptation of the name adds a charming and gentle touch, while its origins draw connections to the Biblical story of Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector who was moved by Jesus' teachings and demonstrated his newfound Spiritual transformation by offering to give back double to those he had defrauded.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Zacchino" carries a profound spiritual significance, reminding us of the transformative power of faith and the importance of living a life guided by moral values. Named after the Biblical character Zacchaeus, it encourages those who bear the name to reflect upon their own character, striving to live a life of purity, righteousness, and true innovation in their hearts and actions. The spiritual significance of "Zacchino" extends beyond its cultural origins, serving as a reminder of the importance of inner transformation and the power of personal repentance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zacchaeus, a shortened form of Zacchino, means "pure, innocent, or righteous one." In the Bible, Zacchaeus, a wealthy chief tax collector, climbed a tree to see Jesus and was moved by His teachings, promising to give half of his wealth to the poor and make amends for any wrongs he had done. This act of repentance and restoration symbolizes spiritual transformation and redemption.

historical_references.reference: Saint Zacchaeus of Calabria, also known as Zacchino, was a Greek Orthodox monk who lived in the 15th century. He is best known for his ascetic life in the Calabrian mountains of southern Italy, where he lived in a tree for over 50 years, only descending to collect firewood and supplies. His devotion to God was legendary, and he was venerated as a saint after his death.
historical_references.context: Greek Orthodox monk, tree-dwelling ascetic in Calabria, Italy

historical_references.reference: Zacchino is also a name used in medieval Italy for the Christ Child, especially in the nativity scene. The term 'Zacchino' comes from the Hebrew name 'Zacharias', which means 'God remembers'. This name was given to the Christ Child to symbolize God's remembrance of His promised Messiah.
